name: pixi-match3
description: Match-3 game: React + TypeScript + PixiJS (WebGL) with a Node.js WebSocket leaderboard and server-side score validation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @match3/server" "npm run dev -w @match3/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @match3/client && npm run build -w @match3/server
